critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/projects.py L355-357: Guard for 'Configurado en espera del Cliente' is implemented correctly. Confirmed 400 from Asignado, 200 from En Gestión.
/app/backend/routes/projects.py L2006-2034 (implementation-fields): Accepts fecha_estimada_produccion as a top-level field, persists null on falsy. Validated via GET round-trip.

/app/backend/routes/projects.py L1100-1105 (subject template render): Regex r'\{\{?\s*[A-Za-z0-9_áéíóúÁÉÍÓÚñÑ]+\s*\}?\}' correctly strips unresolved {Token} from the template subject AFTER variable substitution, then collapses double spaces. NOTE (latent gap, non-blocking): the same cleaning is NOT applied to body.custom_subject in /preview-notification (L1517-1520) — only _render_vars is invoked, so an operator typing '{Token}' literally in the asunto override would still produce '{Token}' in the preview/send. Recommend reusing the same 2-line cleanup on custom_subject for consistency with the requirement '2.3 no imprimir variables fantasma'.

/app/backend/services/signature.py + email_service.py: signature HTML now uses src='cid:firma_logo' and email_service attaches the file inline both in SMTP (multipart/related) and Resend (base64+content_id). Confirmed in preview-email response.

/app/frontend/src/pages/ProjectDetail.jsx L1138-1139: notif-prod-btn is correctly gated by `project.status === 'Configurado en espera del Cliente'`. UI test confirmed visibility toggling on status change.

/app/frontend/src/pages/ProjectDetail.jsx L1112-1124: fecha-produccion-field / fecha-produccion-input render a native HTML <input type='date'> (browser default picker), not a shadcn calendar component. This is per spec ('campo DatePicker' interpreted as native date input). Acceptable, but if the team wants visual consistency with the rest of the app (where shadcn Popover+Calendar is used), this is a candidate for future polish — NOT blocking.
/app/frontend/src/pages/Projects.jsx STATUS_CONFIG: Filter dropdown lists the new status correctly in order (after 'En Gestión', before 'Suspendido').
